eyebrow: Traditional medicine, wellness & personal care manufacturing

highlights.title: Established in 1948
highlights.body: Dragon Prima Farma began with menthol products and expanded into a broad traditional medicine and wellness portfolio.

highlights.title: Certified production
highlights.body: The company highlights CPOTB, Halal, ISO 9001:2015 and CPKB certifications across its quality journey.

highlights.title: Heritage product range
highlights.body: Its portfolio includes menthol, eucalyptus oil, telon oil, balm, aromatherapy, medicated powder and related wellness products.

highlights.title: Domestic & export reach
highlights.body: Dragon Prima Farma positions its products for both Indonesian consumers and international markets.
